Explore cues: calculating the effective temperature of a planet; determining the percentage of solar radiation returned by the greenhouse effect; estimating power loss for objects with varying emissivity; order-of-magnitude checks for radiation at room temperature
excludes: distinguish between absorption area (πR²) and emission area (4πR²)
check if convection/conduction is negligible or must be included in the power balance
ensure temperature is in Kelvin for T^4 calculations
differentiate between ground emission and atmospheric back-radiation
